note: The sfnt resource record contains the input-controlled 24-bit offset that selects where the embedded OpenType face begins relative to the dfont data block.
The vulnerable sanitizer follows the resource map without first validating the declared resource data range using dataLen, so resource offsets are not constrained to the dfont data area.
The data block base is propagated into type-list/resource-record sanitization as the base for sfnt resource offsets.
The malformed candidate sets offset to 1, so sanitization accepts a misaligned face start inside the resource-data blob rather than the true LArray payload start.
The bad offset is dereferenced and cast to an OpenTypeFontFace; subsequent table parsing reads bytes at a bogus face boundary and can run past the intended sfnt resource.
